brief: Pipeline outcome requires the final published value to be within 0.5 of the true measurement. Stage 1 rounds each measurement to one decimal place. Stage 2 rounds its input to an integer, rounding halves up. Both stages follow their stated rounding rules exactly.
artifact: Pipeline publishes stage2(stage1(x)) for all inputs. Release note claims the 0.5 tolerance holds for every possible input.
target_finding: two individually-correct rounding stages compose to an error above the 0.5 tolerance

brief: Three workers each stay within their own per-worker quota: A at most 40 writes, B at most 40 writes, C at most 40 writes. The shared database outcome requires total concurrent writes strictly below 100. No global limiter is present.
artifact: Launch plan runs all three workers at their full per-worker quotas simultaneously and declares the database constraint satisfied because each worker is within its own quota.
target_finding: individually-valid quotas sum to 120 concurrent writes above the sub-100 global limit

brief: Access token is valid for 30 minutes after issue. Step A issues the token at 14:00. Step B runs 20 minutes, then step C runs 20 minutes; C starts only after B completes. Step C must present the same token while it is still valid.
artifact: Execution plan uses the step-A token in step C with no reissue.
target_finding: token expires at 14:30 but step C starts at 14:40

brief: Migration runs in three steps: deploy writer v2 first, leave readers at v1 for 20 minutes, then update readers to v2. Writer v2 begins writing records with a new mandatory field immediately. Reader v1 rejects any record containing an unknown mandatory field. The end state with all components at v2 is fully correct.
artifact: Migration plan declares zero failed reads during the whole migration because the final v2 state is correct.
target_finding: during the 20-minute transitional window v1 readers reject v2 records

brief: Migration runs in three steps: update readers to v2 first, then deploy writer v2, then remove v1. Writer v2 begins writing records with a new mandatory field only after all readers accept it. Reader v2 accepts the new field. The end state is fully correct.
artifact: Migration plan updates readers before the writer starts emitting the new field, and declares zero failed reads.

brief: Migration outcome requires the transitional mixed-version window to stay within the approved limit. The approved limit for mixed-version operation has not been supplied; architecture review will set it next week. Step order and component versions are otherwise fully specified.
artifact: Migration plan lists step order and versions; mixed-window compliance is marked pending the architecture review limit.
target_finding: approved mixed-version window limit is unavailable
